name: census-mcp-server
description: Query U.S. Census Bureau data, variables, and geography via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Query U.S. Census Bureau data, variables, and geography via MCP.
interface.longDescription: Query U.S. Census Bureau data through the official Census Data API. List available datasets and their vintage years (census_list_datasets), search variables by human-readable concept like "median household income" (census_search_variables), and resolve place names to FIPS codes (census_resolve_geography). Retrieve estimates for a single geography (census_query_data) or rank and compare a measure across many geographies (census_compare_geographies), with geography discovery (census_list_geographies), per-variable metadata (census_get_variable), and filter-dimension value lookup (census_list_predicate_values). Runs over stdio or Streamable HTTP; a free CENSUS_API_KEY is required for data queries, while variable search and geography resolution work without one.
